steps.title: Confirm no secrets are committed (.env, google-services, gradle.properties, plist)
Provision staging/production secrets in GitHub, hosting, and Supabase
Validate PWA service worker behavior on real staging/production domain
Validate Capacitor production build has no dev URL and no WebView debug flags
Enable leaked password protection, lock redirect allowlist, and enforce admin MFA
Complete RLS and storage audit using RLS_STORAGE_AUDIT_QUERIES.sql
Dry-run and apply remote Supabase migrations
Validate generated types match remote schema
Validate backup/restore procedure and retention/account deletion cleanup
Set Stripe secret, webhook secret, and publishable key
Configure Stripe webhook endpoint and required events
Populate all required Stripe price IDs and DLC catalog mappings
Validate checkout, webhook processing, entitlement unlock, billing portal, cancel/reactivate
Configure Android Firebase app and FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT secret
Configure APNs key/material secrets for iOS push
Verify remote push delivery on one real Android and one real iOS device
Apply NSFW consent migrations and confirm policy text/versioning
Import NSFW videos/topics/library items via /admin/nsfw
Verify signed URL delivery expiry and offline DRM/expiry behavior
Validate privacy tier defaults, incognito behavior, and panic lock
Confirm final deployment strategy (static hosting or containerized)
Enable CI deploy secrets and verify staging+production deploy jobs execute
Validate rollback path for app and database in a controlled drill
Validate Sentry DSN/env tagging and PII-safe telemetry in staging
Confirm monitoring dashboards and alert thresholds for crashes, API, and webhooks
Run accessibility audit across auth/scanner/diary/settings/store flows
Validate keyboard navigation, SR labels, contrast, and reduced motion
Run k6 load tests (core and NSFW media when applicable)
Validate cold start, scanner FPS/memory, and mobile media memory pressure budgets
Review bundle composition and action any regressions
Sync Android Capacitor project and verify release configuration
Build signed Android AAB
Upload Android build to Play internal track and pass pre-launch report
Sync iOS Capacitor project on macOS with CocoaPods installed
Archive in Xcode and upload build
Complete TestFlight internal validation
Submit iOS build for App Review
Verify privacy policy, terms URL, age rating questionnaire, and compliance answers
Upload final screenshot/creative assets for stores
Validate NSFW/DLC idempotency checks, refunds/disputes, and restore/device-binding tests
Verify /admin/nsfw production access controls and consent gating across modules
